title: plumeria rubra var. acuminata
intro: Plumeria rubra var. acuminata, commonly known as the Singapore Plumeria or the Frangipani, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Plumeria rubra var. acuminata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-spasmodic, and sedative properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include calming the nervous system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
